verification_notes.samples: Before one process per matrix cell, after two. Three-tab rows combine first and subsequent opens; first-tab samples retained separately. Small sequential samples are not population tail estimates.
verification_notes.diagnostics: Opening phases use the separate coarse muffin.perf.open category with existing per-inline parser timers disabled. Off controls disable open scopes. Other interaction phases restore their original diagnostics.
verification_notes.scope_selection: GUI startup-page empty parses can appear while creating later tabs. Parser-stage summaries select the single worker parse, retaining every raw scope.
verification_notes.io: Workload file creation is untimed immediately before opening, so OS file cache is warm. This is not cold-storage I/O.
verification_notes.first_paint: Actual foreground/Qt active/exposed completed full-viewport QWidget Paint after parseBusy(false). Not DWM presentation or native keyboard latency.
verification_notes.memory: 20ms sampled peak can miss short peaks. Process peak is historical since process start. Payload census is untimed after drain; it excludes allocator/Qt/OS internals.

supplemental_static_visual_and_diagnosti.method: Five additional foreground processes with identical updated diagnostic exe source and separately pinned before/after product DLLs. After timed phases, send the editor its standard Qt Leave event before each visual reference; no system cursor manipulation or disabling theme animations. Main-matrix variations retained. One large-file legacy-per-inline diagnostic comparison is sequential and not a stable overhead estimate.
